rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account before accessing order details. It correctly identified the Bluetooth speaker’s price and battery life from the pending order. When asked to cancel the item, the agent explained the platform constraint (no single-item cancellation on a pending order) and offered an exchange instead, which is consistent with available tools. It then listed under-$300 variants and obtained explicit confirmation before performing the order-changing write. The modify call replaced the correct item, and the refund amount matched the price difference. Finally, the agent provided the correct updated order total ($1,288.65) consistent with the tool outputs.
